items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Don Payne, a bass player who worked with us and recorded with us

ctx.x: Oh yeah, count ‘em. And we drove to New York and stopped at a friend’s place, Don Payne, a bass player who worked with us and recorded with us, and we found a place to stay. We get into New York but the only place we could find somewhere was a motel and so in September, putting the kids in school in Riverdale, NY, and we’re making sandwiches in the motel for the kids, and taking them to school and then bringing them back, and looking for an apartment. Finally we looked and looked and looked and looked and nothing…
saw an ad in the paper that said: old house, 5 acres of grounds, private drive, view of the river, and Jackie said, “let’s go look at it.” I said, oh, you know, “it’s going to be an arm and a leg.”
